'''Jobo''' was a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Myykian]] [[youngling]] who lived on [[At Attin]] in the [[New Republic Era]]. Their family consisted of a [[Nooma|mother]], [[Nol|father]], a brother [[Neel]], a twin [[Jorko]] and a sister [[Tuloo]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />

After missing their [[Career Assessment Test]] the [[human]] [[Wim]] came to [[Neel's home|Jobo's home]] looking for Neel while Jobo, Jorko and Tuloo were watching a [[hologram]] performance.<ref name="Real Adventure" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jobo first appeared in the first episode of [[2024]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]".<ref name="Real Adventure" />
